findings.title: Sensitive Information Disclosure - Application Configuration and OAuth Credentials Exposed
findings.description: The application exposes sensitive configuration information through the /rest/admin/application-configuration endpoint without authentication. This includes Google OAuth client ID, security question answers, and complete application configuration.

evidence.description: Exposed application configuration showing OAuth credentials and security answers

remediation: Remove sensitive credentials from client-side configuration endpoints
Implement authentication and authorization checks for admin configuration endpoints
Remove security question answers from public-facing configuration
